A massive '''beaked creature''' lived on a [[Unidentified planet (creature world)|planet]] located in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. During [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], one attacked the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] after they had escaped into an ocean after nearly being killed by a large [[pterosaur]]. Using tentacles, it attempted to eat Kenobi, but Skywalker managed to sever the tentacles with his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], saving Kenobi.
